name: Giulia Puteri
bioAdditions: Giulia Francesca was baptized on 12 March 1717, daughter of Giuseppe Putero and Beatrice Manfrida (S1). An elder sister Giulia had been baptized in 1710. She married Francesco Colosimo on 26 February 1740 (S2).
